toegepas.voor: sonder instrumente en het onder Zoeloe-sprekende
toegepas.na: sonder instrumente en het onder Zoeloesprekende
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS writes compounds with -sprekende as one word (cf. Afrikaanssprekende).
toegepas.fout: Compound with -sprekende written with a hyphen.
toegepas.rede_keurder: AWS writes language-name compounds with -sprekend as one word (cf. Afrikaanssprekende); meaning unchanged.

toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS writes compounds with -sprekende as one word; keep it consistent with the other occurrences.
toegepas.fout: Compound with -sprekende written with a hyphen.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Same AWS spelling fix, consistent with the other two occurrences.

toegepas.voor: gespeel en gesing, albei maklik om saam te dra
toegepas.na: gespeel en gesing, en albei is maklik om saam te dra
toegepas.rede_vinder: The verbless tag 'albei maklik om saam te dra' dangles; a full clause with its own verb reads naturally.
toegepas.fout: Verbless absolute tag copies an English 'both easy to carry' construction.
toegepas.rede_keurder: A full clause with its own verb reads naturally for a Grade 6 reader and keeps the same referent and meaning.

toegepas.voor: dikwels voorop en speel baie groepe
toegepas.na: dikwels voorop, en speel baie groepe
toegepas.rede_vinder: En joins two clauses with their own subject and verb (die kitaar staan / baie groepe speel), so AWS requires a comma.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two clauses with their own subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'die kitaar staan' and 'baie groepe speel' are two full clauses joined by en, so the house comma rule applies.

toegepas.voor: kom oor en oor terug en dit is herhaling
toegepas.na: kom oor en oor terug, en dit is herhaling
toegepas.rede_vinder: En joins two full clauses, so AWS requires a comma.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two full clauses.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'n Kitaarfrase kom terug' and 'dit is herhaling' each have subject and verb; the comma also separates the clause-joining en from 'oor en oor'.

toegepas.voor: Die vinnige praat vorm 'n kontras met die sang.
toegepas.na: Die vinnig gesproke deel vorm 'n kontras met die sang.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Die vinnige praat' uses the verb as a noun awkwardly; 'die vinnig gesproke deel' is natural and matches the lesson's own glossary wording.
toegepas.fout: 'Die vinnige praat' uses a bare verb as a noun awkwardly.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Die vinnig gesproke deel' is natural, refers to the same fast-spoken section and matches the lesson's own izibongo entry.

toegepas.voor: Albei herhaal gesingde reëls en maskandi
toegepas.na: Albei herhaal gesonge reëls, en maskandi
toegepas.rede_vinder: The adjectival participle of sing is 'gesonge', and en joins two full clauses, so AWS requires a comma.
toegepas.fout: 'gesingde' is not the standard adjectival participle, and the AWS comma is missing.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'gesonge' is the correct form and the two full clauses take the comma; meaning unchanged.

toegepas.voor: tussen hoog en laag en maskandi tussen
toegepas.na: tussen hoog en laag, en maskandi tussen
toegepas.rede_vinder: The chain 'hoog en laag en maskandi' blurs where the second clause starts; the comma before the clause-joining en separates them.
toegepas.fout: 'hoog en laag en maskandi' makes a reader stumble over where the second clause starts.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The comma marks the start of the second (gapped) clause and fixes a first-reading stumble without changing what is said.

toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS writes compounds with -sprekende as one word.
toegepas.fout: Compound with -sprekende written with a hyphen.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Same AWS one-word spelling as items 2 and 3.

toegepas.rede_vinder: En joins two clauses with their own subject and verb, so AWS requires a comma.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two clauses with their own subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Albei het gegroei' and 'tog klink hulle' are two full clauses joined by en.

laat_vaar.blok: Twee dinge om na te luister
laat_vaar.voor: Sag teenoor hard is 'n kontras en hoog teenoor laag ook.
laat_vaar.na: Sag teenoor hard is 'n kontras, en hoog teenoor laag is ook een.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The elliptical second clause reads clipped; giving it its own verb makes two full clauses, which then take the AWS comma before en.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The elliptical 'en hoog teenoor laag ook' is natural Afrikaans; 'is ook een' is heavier and only reads differently.

laat_vaar.voor: in plaas van om te sing
laat_vaar.na: in plaas daarvan om te sing
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Before an om te-infinitive the standard construction is 'in plaas daarvan om te'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'in plaas van om te sing' is accepted, natural Afrikaans; the proposal is a lateral, more formal variant.

na_skrywer.rede_vinder: The adjective belongs with koorsang, not with soort; 'n soort Suid-Afrikaanse koorsang' is the natural order.
na_skrywer.fout: 'n Suid-Afrikaanse soort koorsang' attaches the adjective to 'soort' rather than to 'koorsang'.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: A word-order rewording of a glossary definition goes beyond spelling or grammar, so the writer must decide it.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'Zoeloe-soort musiek' is an unnatural compound; 'n soort Zoeloemusiek' is idiomatic and AWS writes the compound as one word.
na_skrywer.fout: 'n Zoeloe-soort musiek' is an unnatural compound.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The fault is real, but rewording a glossary definition belongs to the writer, not a language agent.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.teks: Julle sing hulle almal eenstemmig, in twee dele, in kanon of as 'n rondsang.
vlae.rede: 'Hulle almal eenstemmig' can be read as all songs being sung in unison, with the rest of the list then unclear; whether it means each song in one of these ways, or the class uses all four ways, cannot be settled without guessing the intent, and three of the phrases are protected.
